question: A can do a piece of work in 10 days and B can do it in 15 days. In how many days can they complete the work working together?
explanation: A's 1-day work = 1/10. B's 1-day work = 1/15. Together they do (1/10 + 1/15) = 5/30 = 1/6 of the work in one day. Thus, together they will finish the work in 6 days.

question: [Company Target: Infosys/Accenture] A can do a piece of work in 22 days, and B can do the same work in 33 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/22. B's 1-day rate = 1/33. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/22 + 1/33 = (22+33)/(22*33). Inverting this gives the total days: (22 * 33) / (22 + 33) = 13.2 days.

question: [Company Target: Meta/Uber] A can do a piece of work in 32 days, and B can do the same work in 48 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/32. B's 1-day rate = 1/48. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/32 + 1/48 = (32+48)/(32*48). Inverting this gives the total days: (32 * 48) / (32 + 48) = 19.2 days.

question: [Company Target: Wipro/Amazon] A can do a piece of work in 18 days, and B can do the same work in 27 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Accenture/Goldman Sachs] A can do a piece of work in 40 days, and B can do the same work in 60 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/40. B's 1-day rate = 1/60. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/40 + 1/60 = (40+60)/(40*60). Inverting this gives the total days: (40 * 60) / (40 + 60) = 24 days.

question: [Company Target: Cisco/Meta] A can do a piece of work in 34 days, and B can do the same work in 51 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Samsung/Wipro] A can do a piece of work in 20 days, and B can do the same work in 30 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Apple/Oracle] A can do a piece of work in 28 days, and B can do the same work in 42 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Cognizant/Google] A can do a piece of work in 38 days, and B can do the same work in 57 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: IBM/Samsung] A can do a piece of work in 20 days, and B can do the same work in 30 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Goldman Sachs/Microsoft] A can do a piece of work in 32 days, and B can do the same work in 48 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Wipro/Amazon] A can do a piece of work in 38 days, and B can do the same work in 57 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Intel/TCS] A can do a piece of work in 16 days, and B can do the same work in 24 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Microsoft/Netflix] A can do a piece of work in 24 days, and B can do the same work in 36 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Goldman Sachs/Microsoft] A can do a piece of work in 26 days, and B can do the same work in 39 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/26. B's 1-day rate = 1/39. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/26 + 1/39 = (26+39)/(26*39). Inverting this gives the total days: (26 * 39) / (26 + 39) = 15.6 days.

question: [Company Target: SAP/Infosys] A can do a piece of work in 38 days, and B can do the same work in 57 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/38. B's 1-day rate = 1/57. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/38 + 1/57 = (38+57)/(38*57). Inverting this gives the total days: (38 * 57) / (38 + 57) = 22.8 days.

question: [Company Target: Wipro/Amazon] A can do a piece of work in 32 days, and B can do the same work in 48 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/32. B's 1-day rate = 1/48. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/32 + 1/48 = (32+48)/(32*48). Inverting this gives the total days: (32 * 48) / (32 + 48) = 19.2 days.

question: [Company Target: Netflix/IBM] A can do a piece of work in 16 days, and B can do the same work in 24 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/16. B's 1-day rate = 1/24. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/16 + 1/24 = (16+24)/(16*24). Inverting this gives the total days: (16 * 24) / (16 + 24) = 9.6 days.

question: [Company Target: Accenture/Goldman Sachs] A can do a piece of work in 28 days, and B can do the same work in 42 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?

question: [Company Target: Oracle/SAP] A can do a piece of work in 40 days, and B can do the same work in 60 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
